label: AU-9(6)
title: Read-only Access

statement.prose: Authorize read-only access to audit information to {{ insert: param, au-09.06_odp }}.

guidance: Restricting privileged user or role authorizations to read-only helps to limit the potential damage to organizations that could be initiated by such users or roles, such as deleting audit records to cover up malicious activity.

params.label: subset of privileged users or roles
guidelines: a subset of privileged users or roles with authorized read-only access to audit information is defined;
